verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I would search the whole world through
I could search the heavens too
I would find that only You can satisfy me

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
You're fairer than the sons of men
Chief among ten thousand

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
From the heights to the seas
You stand alone in majesty
From the crown of thorns to your heavenly throne
You are God and God alone

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
You're the glory and the lifter of my head
I lift my eyes up, I lift my eyes up

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
I lift my eyes up to the hills
Where does my help come from?
It comes from You and You alone
